batting.dismissal: c G Gambhir b SP Narine

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b UT Yadav

batting.name: DJG Sammy
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: MK Pandey

balls.text: Umesh ends the innings with an accurate yorker, Steyn makes room outside leg and swings hard, but finds his off stump uprooted
goes after a full delivery outside off, but cannot time it
pace is up at 144.8 kph  but it is a wayward wide, high full toss outside off
backs away to a low full toss and smashes it straight to extra cover

Irfan mishits the pull, but the ball falls in vacant space at midwicket, the evening turns worse for Sunrisers as Karn is found short of his ground with a direct hit, they ran the first, then Irfan turned for the second, Karn responded, Irfan stopped, Karn stopped too, but was way slow in getting his bat in, was not too far down the pitch
full and wide it will be once more, he connects alright this time, but hits it to the sweeper on the bounce, RTD hops to cover the extra bounce
full and wide again, inside the marker, Karn swings and misses
Umesh starts the final over with a 143.5 kph full and wide one, too wide
hit down to long on for a single
this is full just outside off, but he's made some room and squeezed it to short third man, who lets it slip through
slants it full and wide across the left hander at 94 kph, Irfan lifts it, on the bounce, to long off
98 kph and hurled full down leg, Irfan misses the sweep
very full outside off, Irfan cannot get bat to it as it dips under
drives a full one outside off, to the right of long off for a couple
a full toss outside off, Sammy clears front leg and slogs, but he hasn't got enough on it, long off runs to his right and takes it, been a struggle for Sammy tonight
Irfan chops one turning away from him to short third man and he will have ti get back as there is no single
a length ball, he pulls once more, and only gets a single to wide long on
cannot get it away again, this is very full but he does not manage much bat on it as it rolls away onto the pitch
this is an offbreak and cramps him on the pull, which is why it cannot beat midwicket
connects on the pull this time, and drags it wide of long on, who has to dive to stop it
Sammy pulls but does not connect as he has not picked the straighter one that bounces past outside off
sweeps behind square and comes back for the second, it could have been close but he makes it
Irfan skips out, and carts it straight over the bowler, times it well enough to beat the deep fielders
goes back to a length ball and pulls it hard, without much timing, to deep midwicket
Sammy sets himself up and has a heave, but this flighted ball turns in, and the inside edge goes to midwicket
moves forward and pushes, the ball pops up in the air wide of the bowler
a full ball but down the leg side, and Irfan sweeps behind square, easily beats the man in the deep
a length ball on the pad, Irfan works it in front of square and charges down, but he will get only the single as deep midwicket runs in
drags this wide of deep midwicket for a couple
dabs a length ball angled across, to short third man, trots out but has to turn back
squeezes this fuller one behind point for a single
the straighter one, Sammy backs away for the cut but is beaten by the bounce and the lack of turn
slaps a length ball wide of the sweeper, but only getting the single
shorter and flatter, he goes back and hits it straight to cover
right through him, a tossed up googly, Sammy does not pick it as he pushes half forward, is lucky that did not hit off
tosses it up outside off, Sammy is carefully waiting on it and pushes it softly to point
pushed down to long off
tries to push it through extra cover but this one straightens and bounces, and he mistimes it into the pitch
pushes a flighted ball around off to extra cover
punches a 145 kph back of a length ball to the sweeper
was winding up with a big backlift, saw it angling into the pad again, and worked it square
forces it off the pad to the left of fine leg, and charges back for the second, needs to dive in, and does so
almost pops up to cover, he tries to turn a back of a length ball to the leg side and gets a leading edge
could have been another boundary, this was shortish and Warner's sent it rocketing with a front-foot pull but he's found midwicket in the way
slants a slower length ball across Warner, who winds up and slams it between sweeper cover and long off
stays back to a good length googly and works it down to long on
a full one around off, turned to long on
he gets Rahul with the googly, bowls it on a length just outside off, Rahul decides to play from the crease, it spins in and hits him plumb in front
90 kph flat and wide, cut straight to the sweeper
back and across to a tossed up delivery, defends it safely
comes down the track to a legbreak and turns it from outside off through midwicket
hops and runs this short of a length ball behind point, who slides and stops it
pitched up again, around middle, tapped in front of point for a single
thick outside edge flies past the keeper as Warner pushes from the crease to one leaving him
Morne pitches it up again, width for Warner and he reaches out to slam it well wide of sweeper cover
stays on the crease to a 144.4 kph pitched-up ball outside off and runs it to third man
a length ball around off is pushed down the ground, mid off is up and he reaches it
googly around off stump, steered to short third man
slaps a wrong 'un square on the off side
did him in the flight there, Rahul skipped out to a flighted one, wasn't quite to the pitch as he pushed at it, he slipped and ended up scooping it over the bowler
slightly short on middle, Rahul is quick to latch on and pull it past deep midwicket
reaches a wide legbreak and slaps it to extra cover
starts with one going across the left hander, it is worked down to long on
goes across to the offside and laps this straighter delivery fine on the leg side for a smartly controlled boundary, uses the bowler's pace
stays in the crease and defends this to midwicket
flatter and quicker, comes in after pitching, the batsman defends
comes forward and pushes the slower delivery to long-off
he is not holding back! Everytime he sees a bit of flight he launches into it. This one is whacked deep over the midwicket boundary
bowls a straighter one outside off, the batsman pushes it through cover for a single
fuller this time, he comes forward and pushes it to long-on to get off the mark
slower still and it keeps coming in, the batsman inside edges it on to his pads
tossed up and slower, Rahul comes forward and defends
caught at backward point, Shakib bowls it very full and widish outside off, Ojha bends and squeezes it in the air, straight to the fielder
turned straight to midwicket
Ojha gets a full one right under the bat on middle and off, and carts it straight over the bowler, it falls just before the sightscreen
length ball on off pushed wide of backward point for a single
similar delivery, he tries to run it past short third man, but misses this time
a good length ball around off, Ojha glides it to short third man, is not getting the single
he pitches it up this time, a slower one at 101 kph, and Ojha sends it soaring over the long on boundary
short of a length again, 121.5 kph, he tries the cut and misses
shortish ball sits up outside off, but is flayed straight to long on
bowled slower, bounces from a good length, is pushed to point off the front foot
worked square on the leg side for a single
couple of steps out a tossed up ball, reaches the pitch and smacks it over wide long on with the turn
missed stumping, Ojha's charged out to one that does not turn, carries in with the angle past his swipe, but Uthappa cannot collect it
stays back this time and drags a flat length ball to deep square leg
walks out, is not quite to the pitch and pushes it back to the bowler
defended off the front foot
turning away from the right hander, pushed square on the off side

after missing the sweep, Dhawan's lunged forward and tried a bigger one to this full offbreak outside off, he's only top-edged it, Gambhir at square leg settles under it, it pops out on the first attempt, but he takes it safely on the second
length ball on the pad turned to square leg, non-striker has to get back
appeal for leg before as Dhawan misses the sweep to a full one, but it pitched outside leg
tosses it up full on middle and leg, it is pushed past the non striker to long on
tries the pull to a short of a length ball around off but misses it
full outside off, but Dhawan's squeezed this deftly to the fine third man boundary

plenty of bounce on this 148.2 kph short of a length ball but slanted well down leg, Uthappa takes it as he moves to his left, he carries on moving for an instant, and that is enough for them to pinch a bye
he makes lots of room outside leg to a 150.6 kph delivery slanted across, but misses
not more than a push to this pitched up ball, but it races off the middle of the bat past extra cover to the boundary
taps it softly on the off side for a single
worked off the pad to fine leg
denies him width with a back of a length ball on the stumps, Dhawan dabs it to third man
this is a 148 kph delivery, but it is wide again, and this time he connects on the cut, absolutely no hope for third man
has a go at the cut on this widish short of a length ball angled across him, but misses, that climbed a lot
plays this good length ball from the crease, defends it solidly
Umesh starts with a 144 kph length ball that moves in to the right hander, who nudges it in front of square
they steal a single with a nudge in front of midwicket, fielder dives forward but he cannot pick up the ball, and Ojha is home by then anyway
plays out a 146.4 kph short of a length ball to point and stops the non-striker, who was rushing up for a single
gets behind the line of a back of a length ball and defends down the pitch
full and furious from Morne at 148.2 kph but directed just down the leg side
blocks a short of a length ball from the crease

that is a strange effort from Narine at fine leg, this was tucked neatly off the pad, and the offspinner wasn't too far from it, it was indeed travelling but Narine gives up way too soon, forget diving, he does not even try to outrun it, Morne throws his hands up in frustration
taps a back of a length ball close to the track on off and takes the single
ends with a 143.4 kph outswinger on off stump that is softly pushed to point
swings away full and late, Ojha moves forward and carefully opens the face to defend to covers
Umesh straightens this on Ojha at 146 kph, pitches back of a length and opens him up, the ball falls well short of slip, not sure if that was bat or thigh pad

similar delivery, same response from the batsman, similar direction to the ball, Finch drives half-forward at another late outswinger, but this one zooms closer to third man, and Morne slides to his left to take a sharp catch,
there is a slip, but this outside edge flies past him as Finch goes hard at a pitched up ball that swings away quite late
is hurried on the pull on his 140 kph short ball, tries to take it from outside off, Shakib is after the top edge from square leg, he dives too, but it falls out of his reach, nice try though
Dhawan ends the over on a high, Morne gives him slight width on the length ball and Dhawan flays it past cover

caught on the crease with a good length ball that comes in, it pops up close to the pitch on leg, Morne runs for the ball, Dhawan for the single, Morne tries to push Dhawan out of the way, and immediately apologises, batsman and bowler shake hands to confirm all is well
short of a length at 146 kph but that does not help as it starts outside leg and moves further down, keeper dives and parries it away
Morne goes for the yorker, gets it right just outside off, but Finch manages to bring down some bat on it, just in time, and the ball rolls to fine leg
short of a length, angled into the right hander, he tries to force it past square leg, cannot beat Shakib there
slightly fuller, at 147.3 kph, Finch prefers to stay on the crease, even off the fuller length, the ball kicks, and he has to hop to play it down
starts his favoured back of a length, some way outside off, left alone, decent carry to the keeper
Yusuf lets out a long, never-ending scream as RTD flays a full delivery straight down the ground to finish the job for KKR
a yorker, he's squeezed it off the stumps to backward point, the throw misses at the non-striker's and they taken one more
Tendo does it, he makes room outside leg, Bhuvneshwar goes full on middle and off, Tendo launches it flat over extra cover, and it is timed so well it goes just over the rope
low full toss turned in the gap wide of deep midwicket but Warner races across to keep them to one
shuffles across, opens up but can only get a single to deep midwicket as Steyn is very full on the stumps again
moves outside off and turns the full toss to deep midwicket
nearly 150 kph length ball from Steyn, RTD has a swing and miss outside off
Yusuf walks across once more, he wants to work a full delivery to leg, but it swings away very late, and the leading edge goes over point
Yusuf moves across and swings hard at a full delivery, slices it over point, comes back for the second, has to dive in, makes it
opens the face on a length ball and takes the single to third man
one more full toss, around off, forced to long on
full and wide goes Bhuvneshwar, Yusuf has a heave, thick edge races to third man
full on the pads, worked to Irfan at square leg
full and wide, RTD square drives in the air and picks up four to the deep backward point boundary, one bounce and over the rope
another full toss, Yusuf swipes, it flies down to long off along the ground
Yusuf gets maximum off the first ball of the over, it is a full toss, and he mows it over deep midwicket
yet another full toss, quite wide too, Yusuf slams it straight to extra cover
a low full toss driven wide of the sweeper, there could have been a second, but Yusuf slipped while trying to turn
Irfan keeping it full outside off, Yusuf slogs but only drags it to deep midwicket
he moves outside off stump again, Irfan follows him with a full one, only a single to long on
a full delivery outside off squeezed to third man
moves outside off stump and dabs a length delivery to third man
moves a leg to the on side to try and disturb the bowler, Karn is not, does not give him room with a pitched up ball on the stumps, RTD pushes it softly to long on
comes forward to a 88 kph fullish delivery and pushes it back
not too short, Yusuf pulls it wide of long on
a low full toss is driven to long off
Pandey departs, never really looked in touch, he slogged this full delivery straight to Finch at long on, he takes it it just over his head
flat and quick down the pads, worked to deep square leg

Sammy's made it look more difficult than it was, almost pulled off a stunner before dropping it, Pandey swung and mishit over the captain at extra cover, Sammy went back, but not enough, he had to dive in the end, got both hands to it, but could not hold on as he landed
hit hard down to long off
has another heave at a tossed up legbreak, it lands on the crease off an inside edge
a full toss just outside off, Yusuf moves to off and hammers it over deep midwicket
gets too close to the pitch as he jumps out and forces it to long on
slides on with the angle towards middle, is turned in front of square
stands outside leg before the ball is bowled, Karn bowls it just outside leg, Yusuf cannot find much power as he hits to Steyn's left at long off, fast bowler does not allow a second
pitched up around middle, he is forward to block
tossed up and fuller, swatted to deep midwicket
worked off middle to deep midwicket, Warner sprints in and keeps them to one
arches back and cuts to sweeper cover
skips out but Karn shortens the length, and he pushes it back
a widish length ball even as Pandey makes some room outside leg, slaps it to sweeper cover in the end
sharp bouncer at 148.5 kph, Pandey clears front leg and prepares to have a whack at it, it's too quick
back of a length ball steered to third man
moves across and behind the line of a short of a good length ball to defend
short of a length, widish, Yusuf cuts, Irfan it is who runs across from third man, he dives awkwardly, in vain, should have cut it off
steers a 146 kph widish length ball to third man
turned to deep midwicket for a single
flatter one headed down the pads, Pandey pulls it off the front foot between deep square leg and deep midwicket
googly hits the pad as Pandey pushes forward, sliding down
Pandey's hardly timed anything so far, but he's lofted this flighted legbreak over the extra cover boundary now
full and down the pad once more, Pandey sweeps it calmly to the fine leg boundary
flat and sliding down the pad, he tries to lift it behind square, misses
turned to square leg
reaches for a wide one but drags it down to long off without any timing
full delivery drilled down to long off
tries to cut but this is a slower one too, there is an appeal for caught behind, turned down, did not seem to be an edge
a slower one on the stumps, Yusuf plays it back
Yusuf gets going against brother with a sharp cut to the deep backward point rope, slight width from Irfan and that was enough for Yusuf
on the front foot to nudge a 91 kph delivery behind square leg

uh oh, Uthappa is walking even as keeper appeals for run out, he wanted the single after working it to short fine leg, had to turn back as the throw came in, Uthappa would have been in had the bat not slipped out from his hand, which is why he walked off immediately, he knew it
Mishra responds with a googly that spins in from outside off and beats Uthappa on the cut
excellently done, he's made room again outside leg, this is headed for the stumps from a good length, but he's reacted quickly to slap it high over extra cover
forward to push a tossed up ball to deep point
full delivery on middle, worked to deep midwicket
pushes a length ball to Sammy at extra cover, he threatens to throw it at the non-striker's end, Uthappa has to turn around and hurry back
hit to sweeper cover for a single
Irfan goes short at 132 kph, Uthappa is a bit awkward on the pull as it climbs, but he clears midwicket easily
comes down the track but can only force it past cover for one
full delivery outside off, driven down to long off
goes after a full one slanted across him, but mishits it, gets the single to sweeper cover
turned through midwicket for a couple
slightly fuller this time, around middle, Uthappa makes some more room and launches it cleanly over extra cover
another single to long off as he pushes at a full one
comes down the track and drives along the ground to long off
he backs away to one on middle stump and cuts hard, but straight to backward point
comes forward to a pitched up ball outside off and pushes to long off
length ball worked to deep midwicket
waits as this googly turns in and he defends to point
wrong 'un brushes the pad and runs fine as Uthappa comes forward, didn't pick it
goes on the back foot and slaps the length delivery over a jumping extra cover
pushes a tossed up ball to the off side
was that an edge, this slides in with the angle at 88 kph as Uthappa backs away and misses, it almost hits the middle stump, bounces just over in the end, keeper cannot collect
a good length ball on off at 147 kph, Uthappa works it to the right of mid on
Steyn is not liking this, he's shoved Uthappa away as he runs up the pitch to field the ball after Uthappa defends the short of a length ball and looks for a single
Uthappe continues to attack Steyn, now he is beaten on the pull
147 kph length ball outside off, Uthappa swings and misses
next ball after the drop goes for six, Steyn angles it into the pad, and Uthappa connects so well on the flick it goes well over the man at deep midwicket

Dhawan's dropped it going back from cover, they brought Steyn bakc and Uthappa skied the length ball as he went half-heartedly after it, three men went after it from the infield, Dhawan was the nearest to the ball, he got both hands to it, but it popped out
takes it from around off and works it to mid on for a single
good length just outside off, he opens the face and steers it to third man
short at 127 kph outside off, Pandey slaps it down the ground in the air, well clear of mid off
short of a length, pushed to cover
shortish, but he gets away as it is pulled to deep midwicket
a length ball outside off is pushed back in the air, but it falls just short of the captain as he bends
leaves the crease again, but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball, it carries on straight and he defends
pitching around leg on a length and spinning across, Uthappa pulls but straight to deep midwicket
tries to pull this 87 kph length delivery but mishits it to long on
some turn and bounce just outside off, pushed back to the bowler
beaten as he comes out to this flighted ball, is hit on the leg
leans forward to a tossed up ball and pushes it to mid off
climbs as it moves in from outside off, Uthappa is forward to bring it down
swings in from a length outside off, Uthappa pushes it nicely with the movement, finds midwicket
on the front foot again to defend square on the off side
this straightens outside off, but Uthappa pushes forward very solidly and beats Irfan's dive at shortish mid on
jags in sharply and hits him on the thigh pad
back of a length ball guided to point, non-striker wants the single, there isn't any

big appeal! Gambhir swings at this length delivery, this was angled across. He wanted to whack it over cover, but there doesn't seem to be any edge. Gambhir is upset, very very upset. He is still mouthing stuff even after getting back in the dug out, the ball swung away after it passed the bat, maybe that influenced the umpire
length delivery on off, punched back to the bowler
not much swing for Steyn. This one is on the off stump, Gambhir dabs it to cover off the back foot
this one could have been risky but Gambhir makes it to the other end in time. Robin pushed it softly to the left of Warner at point
back of length on the body, Gambhir hops on his toes and nudges it behind square on the leg side for another quick single
he comes forward and crunches this length delivery to cover, he timed it beautifully, but straight to the fielder
this one comes in from a length, Gambhir nudges it to square leg for a quick single
this one comes in to him but Gambhir gets on top of that and despite there not being much room, he smashes it behind point for a boundary
he steps out of the crease and wants to smack it over the infield, but this one swings away again and beats the outside edge
this one swings away and flies past the outside edge as Gambhir attempts his trademark poke to third man
he walks down the pitch to the back of length delivery, defends it to point
starts off with a short of length outswinger, Uthappa dabs it to gully for a quick single
